short: CTC decoder (M06), concatenated training sentences (M03) and six IMUs (M05) are standard: CTC silent-phrase decoding predates it; 97.17% is a word ratio on 4 people, split unstated.
position: The paper [@xie2025sixaxis] changes the decoder (M06, Conformer with CTC), the training data (M03, concatenated words plus noise) and the sensing (M05, six six-axis IMUs); all three are standard. CTC decoding of silently articulated phrases predates it, with 15 subjects [@chen2023hdsemg], and the cited Luo et al. already trained CTC for silent sentences [@luo2020acoustic], so the claim that no prior SSI recognizes sentences dynamically (§1) fails. Liu et al. trained IMU decoders on concatenated sentences and tested on spoken ones [@liu2024lipimu]; this paper does not say whether its length curve (Fig. 3a) scores recorded or concatenated sequences. The headline 97.17% is a word ratio on 4 participants with an unstated split.
